title: Do You Need to Be Fit for a Safari?
excerpt: A safari is not physically demanding, but some fitness makes long drives and walking safaris more comfortable.
body:
## Game drives

Mostly sitting, with bumpy roads. Core strength and flexibility help.

## Walking safaris

Walks of a few hours on uneven ground.

## Kilimanjaro

A different story. See [the training plan](/blog/kilimanjaro-training-plan/).

## Tips

- Stretch during breaks.
- Drink enough.
- Choose fewer long drives.

## Limited mobility

See [accessible safari](/blog/accessible-safari/).

[Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
